positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 4% above its local comparables; 37 of 54 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $1,870,900 ($1,265 psf, 1,313–1,539 sq ft; 6 resales, Feb 2024–Jan 2026); 6 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,216 psf (range $1,080–2,020); 4% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $72,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Beauty World MRT about 740 m, Hume MRT about 920 m; closer than 28 of 94 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 3 within 2 km; nearest Pei Hwa Presbyterian Primary School about 1,140 m; more than 0 of 94 similar developments (the same as 18). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 680 m), more than 22 of 94 similar developments (the same as 12); nearest hawker centre Bukit Timah Interim Hawker Centre And Market about 820 m; nearest park Rail Corridor about 90 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 4 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Sen, 177 new sales, about 570 m; 8@BT, 34 new sales, about 840 m; The Reserve Residences, 2 new sales, about 1,000 m; Hillhaven, 13 new sales, about 1,910 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 94 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 226 new sales and 530 resales (756 purchases); new sales were 29.9% of these purchases. Subsales (13) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 530 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 61 of 94 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 530 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 546 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−2.9%). Planning-area private resales −27.4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
